name: MRI Registration QC: Pairwise Group Comparison  (FA maps)
summary: An automated quality-check pipeline for multi-image MRI registration comparison.

parameters.description: A visualization that alternates patches of two images in a checkerboard pattern to highlight local alignment differences.

A threshold-based mask applied to both fixed and moving images to compute overlap metrics (e.g., Dice), where a single value (LOW) selects voxels with values > LOW, and two values (LOW,HIGH) select voxels with LOW < value < HIGH.
